nodes.label: Adaptive Icon Foreground Layer (ic_launcher_foreground)
nodes.rationale: Android adaptive icons (API 26+) split the launcher icon into a background and a foreground layer on a 108dp canvas; the foreground is exported once per density bucket (mdpi 108px, hdpi 162px, xhdpi 216px, xxhdpi 324px, xxxhdpi 432px) so the launcher picks a crisp bitmap for the device. The artwork is kept small and centered (roughly the middle half of the canvas) so it stays inside the ~66dp safe zone and is not clipped by circle/squircle masks or parallax/pulse animations.

nodes.label: Orange Smiling Semicircle Mascot (app brand mark)
nodes.rationale: Flat, friendly mascot (orange half-sun/half-coin shape with a smile) used as the Libro-caja app's launcher glyph; minimal shapes and a single saturated hue keep it legible at 48dp and consistent across all density exports.
